http_400.en: The request is invalid. Check the parameters and try again.
http_400.zh: 请求无效，请检查参数后重试。

http_401.en: Authentication failed. Reopen the Agent page or check the access token.
http_401.zh: 身份验证失败，请重新打开 Agent 页面或检查访问凭证。

http_403.en: Access to this resource is forbidden.

http_404.en: The requested resource or API was not found.
http_404.zh: 请求的资源或接口不存在。

http_405.en: This API does not support the request method.
http_405.zh: 此接口不支持当前请求方法。

http_408.en: The request timed out. Try again later.

http_409.en: The operation conflicts with the current state. Refresh and retry.
http_409.zh: 操作与当前状态冲突，请刷新后重试。

http_413.en: The request is too large. Reduce its content or attachments.
http_413.zh: 请求内容过大，请减少内容或附件。

http_415.en: The request content type is unsupported.
http_415.zh: 不支持此请求内容类型。

http_422.en: The request could not be processed. Check the parameters.
http_422.zh: 无法处理此请求，请检查参数。

http_429.en: Too many requests. Try again later.
http_429.zh: 请求过于频繁，请稍后重试。

http_500.en: The backend failed to process the request. Check the service logs.
http_500.zh: 后台处理请求失败，请查看服务日志。

http_502.en: The upstream service returned an invalid response. Check the Agent connection.
http_502.zh: 上游服务响应异常，请检查 Agent 连接。

http_503.en: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
http_503.zh: 服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试。

http_504.en: The upstream service timed out. Try again later.
http_504.zh: 上游服务响应超时，请稍后重试。

request_failed.en: The request failed. Please try again.

agent_discovery_in_progress.en: Wait for Agent discovery to finish before switching Agents.
agent_discovery_in_progress.zh: 请等待 Agent 自动扫描完成后再切换。

agent_unavailable.en: The selected Agent is unavailable. Refresh the Agent list or check its configuration.
agent_unavailable.zh: 所选 Agent 不可用，请刷新 Agent 列表或检查配置。

agent_switch_failed.en: Failed to start the selected Agent. Check its startup command and service logs.
agent_switch_failed.zh: 所选 Agent 启动失败，请检查启动命令及服务日志。

agent_discovery_failed.en: Automatic Agent discovery failed. Check the service logs and try refreshing again.
agent_discovery_failed.zh: Agent 自动扫描失败，请查看服务日志后重新刷新。

capability_conflict.en: A capability with this name already exists.

capability_execution_failed.en: The capability could not be executed. Check the service logs.
capability_execution_failed.zh: 能力执行失败，请查看服务日志。

capability_denied_by_user.en: The capability operation was denied by the user.
capability_denied_by_user.zh: 用户拒绝了此能力操作。

capability_concurrent.en: Another capability operation is in progress.
capability_concurrent.zh: 另一项能力操作正在执行，请稍后重试。

capability_request_failed.en: The capability request failed. Check the service connection.
capability_request_failed.zh: 能力请求失败，请检查服务连接。

capability_response_invalid.en: The capability returned an invalid response.

tool_execution_failed.en: The tool could not be executed. Check the service logs.
tool_execution_failed.zh: 工具执行失败，请查看服务日志。

tool_not_found.en: The requested tool was not found.

tool_outcome_unknown.en: The operation result is unknown. Check the current state before retrying.
tool_outcome_unknown.zh: 操作结果未知，请先检查当前状态再重试。

command_result_invalid.en: The command returned an invalid result.

cli_start_failed.en: The command-line tool could not start. Check its installation and startup command.
cli_start_failed.zh: 命令行工具启动失败，请检查安装情况和启动命令。

cli_exit_nonzero.en: The command-line tool exited with an error. Check the service logs.
cli_exit_nonzero.zh: 命令行工具异常退出，请查看服务日志。

cli_output_limit.en: The command output exceeded the limit. Narrow the query.
cli_output_limit.zh: 命令输出超出限制，请缩小查询范围。

cli_busy.en: The command-line tool is busy. Try again later.
cli_busy.zh: 命令行工具正忙，请稍后重试。

bash_input_invalid.en: The shell command input is invalid.

bash_denied_by_user.en: The shell command was denied by the user.
bash_denied_by_user.zh: 用户拒绝了此 Shell 命令。

bash_policy_denied.en: The shell command is blocked by the permission policy.
bash_policy_denied.zh: 权限策略禁止执行此 Shell 命令。

bash_start_failed.en: The shell command could not start.

bash_output_limit.en: The shell output exceeded the limit. Narrow the query.
bash_output_limit.zh: Shell 输出超出限制，请缩小查询范围。

bash_concurrent.en: Another shell command is running. Try again later.
bash_concurrent.zh: 另一条 Shell 命令正在执行，请稍后重试。

skill_path_escape.en: The skill path is outside the permitted directory.
skill_path_escape.zh: 技能路径超出允许访问的目录范围。

skill_load_failed.en: The skill could not be loaded.

rag_busy.en: Knowledge retrieval is busy. Try again later.
rag_busy.zh: 知识检索正忙，请稍后重试。

rag_retrieval_failed.en: Knowledge retrieval failed. Check the knowledge package and service logs.
rag_retrieval_failed.zh: 知识检索失败，请检查知识包及服务日志。

table_not_ready.en: The table is not ready. Wait and retry.
table_not_ready.zh: 表格尚未就绪，请稍后重试。

table_busy.en: The table is busy. Try again later.

table_state_stale.en: The table state has changed. Refresh it before retrying.
table_state_stale.zh: 表格状态已更改，请刷新后重试。

table_capability_unsupported.en: The table does not support this operation.

table_command_invalid.en: The table command or its arguments are invalid.
table_command_invalid.zh: 表格操作命令或参数无效。

table_column_unknown.en: The requested table column does not exist.

table_filter_unsupported.en: The table does not support this filter.
table_filter_unsupported.zh: 此表格不支持该筛选条件。

table_filter_value_invalid.en: The table filter value is invalid.

table_sort_unsupported.en: The table does not support this sort order.
table_sort_unsupported.zh: 此表格不支持该排序方式。

table_page_out_of_range.en: The requested table page is out of range.
table_page_out_of_range.zh: 请求的表格页码超出范围。

table_row_unknown.en: The requested table row does not exist.

table_selection_limit_exceeded.en: The table selection exceeds the limit. Select fewer rows.
table_selection_limit_exceeded.zh: 表格选择数量超出限制，请减少选中行数。

table_expansion_limit_exceeded.en: Too many table rows are expanded. Collapse some rows and retry.
table_expansion_limit_exceeded.zh: 展开的表格行数超出限制，请收起部分行后重试。

table_command_superseded.en: The table operation was superseded by a newer operation.
table_command_superseded.zh: 表格操作已被更新的操作替代。

table_transition_failed.en: The table state could not be changed.

table_copy_failed.en: The table content could not be copied.

table_connection_lost.en: The table connection was lost. Reopen the page.
table_connection_lost.zh: 表格连接已断开，请重新打开页面。

internal_error.en: The backend failed to process the request. Check the service logs for details.
internal_error.zh: 后台处理请求失败，请查看服务日志了解详情。

backend_starting.zh: Agent 后台正在启动，请稍候。

backend_unavailable.en: Unable to connect to the Agent backend. Check that Node.js is installed and the service is running.
backend_unavailable.zh: 无法连接 Agent 后台，请确认已安装 Node.js 且服务已启动。

invalid_response.en: The backend returned an invalid JSON response (HTTP {status}).
invalid_response.zh: 后台返回的数据不是有效的 JSON（HTTP {status}）。

invalid_json.en: Request body must be valid JSON.
invalid_json.zh: 请求内容必须是有效的 JSON。

request_body_too_large.en: Request body is too large. Reduce the message or attachments.
request_body_too_large.zh: 请求内容过大，请缩短消息或减少附件。

unauthorized.en: The ACP capability token is missing or invalid. Reopen the Agent page.
unauthorized.zh: ACP 访问凭证缺失或无效，请重新打开 Agent 页面。

agent_busy.en: The Agent is busy. Wait for the current message or permission request to finish.
agent_busy.zh: Agent 正忙，请等待当前消息或权限请求处理完成。

agent_config_read_failed.en: Agent settings could not be read. Check the local configuration files and permissions.
agent_config_read_failed.zh: 无法读取 Agent 设置，请检查本地配置文件及访问权限。

validation_failed.en: Invalid configuration. Check the fields and try again.
validation_failed.zh: 配置无效，请检查各项设置后重试。

duplicate_agent_launch.en: ACP launch command duplicates configured agent: {conflictingAgent}
duplicate_agent_launch.zh: ACP 启动命令与已配置的 Agent 重复：{conflictingAgent}

config_write_failed.en: Could not save settings. Check disk space and configuration directory permissions.
config_write_failed.zh: 无法保存设置，请检查磁盘空间及配置目录的写入权限。

reload_failed.en: Settings were saved, but the Agent could not be reloaded. Check settings and restart the service.
reload_failed.zh: 设置已保存，但 Agent 重新加载失败，请检查配置并重启服务。

model_list_unsupported.en: The provider is unsupported or the base URL is invalid.
model_list_unsupported.zh: 不支持此服务提供商，或基础 URL 无效。

secret_endpoint_changed.en: Enter an API key for the changed endpoint.
secret_endpoint_changed.zh: 服务地址已更改，请重新输入 API Key。

model_list_secret_invalid.en: The API key could not be read. Enter it again.
model_list_secret_invalid.zh: 无法读取 API Key，请重新输入。

model_list_failed.en: Could not fetch models. Check settings or enter models in JSON.
model_list_failed.zh: 无法获取模型列表，请检查配置，或通过 JSON 手动填写模型。

secret_ciphertext_invalid.en: The stored secret is invalid. Enter it again.
secret_ciphertext_invalid.zh: 已保存的密钥无效，请重新输入。

crypto_unwrap_failed.en: The secret could not be decrypted. Enter it again and retry.
crypto_unwrap_failed.zh: 密钥解密失败，请重新输入后重试。

secret_placeholder_invalid.en: A new secret must be entered; a placeholder cannot be reused.
secret_placeholder_invalid.zh: 新增密钥时必须输入实际值，不能使用占位符。

plaintext_secret_rejected.en: Plaintext secrets are not accepted. Refresh the page and enter the secret again.
plaintext_secret_rejected.zh: 不接受明文密钥，请刷新页面后重新输入。

secrets_key_protection_failed.en: The encryption key could not be protected. Check the service logs.
secrets_key_protection_failed.zh: 加密密钥保护失败，请查看服务日志。

secrets_key_invalid.en: The encryption key is invalid or unavailable for the current user. Check the service logs.
secrets_key_invalid.zh: 加密密钥无效或当前用户无法访问，请查看服务日志。

invalid_prompt_preset.zh: 所选助手提示词预设不存在。

prompt_preset_unavailable.en: The selected assistant prompt is unavailable.
prompt_preset_unavailable.zh: 所选助手的提示词不可用。

empty_prompt.en: Enter a message or attach an image before sending.
empty_prompt.zh: 请先输入消息或添加图片再发送。

agent_not_ready.en: The selected Agent is not initialized. Check its startup configuration.
agent_not_ready.zh: 所选 Agent 尚未初始化，请检查其启动配置。

agent_not_configured.en: The selected Agent is not configured. Complete its settings before sending messages.
agent_not_configured.zh: 所选 Agent 尚未配置，请完善设置后再发送消息。

session_id_required.en: A session ID is required. Select or create a session first.
session_id_required.zh: 缺少会话 ID，请先选择或创建会话。

prompt_in_progress.en: Another message is already being processed in this session.
prompt_in_progress.zh: 此会话正在处理另一条消息，请稍候。

prompt_setup_failed.en: The message could not be prepared for the selected Agent.
prompt_setup_failed.zh: 无法为所选 Agent 准备消息，请查看服务日志。

session_list_failed.en: Could not load the session list. Check the Agent connection.
session_list_failed.zh: 无法加载会话列表，请检查 Agent 连接。

session_create_failed.en: The selected Agent could not create a new session.
session_create_failed.zh: 所选 Agent 无法创建新会话。

session_load_unsupported.en: The selected Agent does not support loading existing sessions.
session_load_unsupported.zh: 所选 Agent 不支持加载已有会话。

session_not_found.en: The selected Agent could not find this session.
session_not_found.zh: 所选 Agent 找不到此会话。

session_load_failed.en: The selected Agent could not load this session.
session_load_failed.zh: 所选 Agent 无法加载此会话。

session_busy.en: The session cannot be deleted while a message is being processed.
session_busy.zh: 消息处理期间无法删除会话。

session_delete_unsupported.en: The selected Agent does not support deleting sessions.
session_delete_unsupported.zh: 所选 Agent 不支持删除会话。

session_delete_failed.en: The selected Agent could not delete this session.
session_delete_failed.zh: 所选 Agent 无法删除此会话。

config_options_unsupported.en: The selected Agent does not support session configuration options.
config_options_unsupported.zh: 所选 Agent 不支持会话配置选项。

config_option_locked.en: The session option cannot be changed while the Agent is processing a message.
config_option_locked.zh: Agent 处理消息期间无法修改会话选项。

invalid_config_option.en: The requested session option or value is unavailable.
invalid_config_option.zh: 所选会话选项或选项值不可用。

config_option_update_failed.en: The selected Agent failed to update the session option.
config_option_update_failed.zh: 所选 Agent 更新会话选项失败。

model_selection_unsupported.en: The selected Agent does not expose a configurable model option.
model_selection_unsupported.zh: 所选 Agent 不支持切换模型。

model_unavailable.en: The selected model is not available for this Agent.
model_unavailable.zh: 此 Agent 不支持所选模型。

mode_required.en: A session mode must be selected.

mode_selection_unsupported.en: The selected Agent does not expose a configurable session mode.
mode_selection_unsupported.zh: 所选 Agent 不支持切换会话模式。

invalid_permission_response.en: A session ID, request ID and valid permission decision are required.
invalid_permission_response.zh: 权限响应必须包含会话 ID、请求 ID 和有效的授权决定。

permission_request_not_found.en: The permission request does not exist or is no longer available.
permission_request_not_found.zh: 权限请求不存在或已失效。

permission_request_resolved.en: The permission request has already been resolved.
permission_request_resolved.zh: 此权限请求已处理，请勿重复操作。

invalid_context.en: The context must be a valid object.
invalid_context.zh: 上下文必须是有效的对象。

host_owned_field.en: Host-managed context fields cannot be changed.
host_owned_field.zh: 不能修改由宿主管理的上下文字段。

request_id_required.en: A frontend command request ID is required.
request_id_required.zh: 缺少前端操作请求 ID。

invalid_command_response.en: The frontend command response is incomplete or invalid.
invalid_command_response.zh: 前端操作响应不完整或无效。

command_invalid.en: The command or its arguments are invalid.

command_not_found.en: The requested command was not found.
command_not_found.zh: 请求的操作命令不存在。

command_permission_denied.en: Permission to execute the command was denied.

command_timeout.en: The command timed out. Check the page and try again.
command_timeout.zh: 操作超时，请检查页面后重试。

command_busy.en: Another operation is in progress. Try again later.
command_busy.zh: 另一项操作正在进行，请稍后重试。

command_unavailable.en: This operation is unavailable on the current page.
command_unavailable.zh: 当前页面不支持此操作。

command_connection_lost.en: The page connection was lost. Reopen the page and try again.
command_connection_lost.zh: 页面连接已断开，请重新打开页面后重试。

command_execution_failed.en: The command could not be executed. Check the service logs.
command_execution_failed.zh: 操作执行失败，请查看服务日志。

capability_auth_failed.zh: 内置能力身份验证失败。

capability_not_found.en: The requested capability or resource was not found.
capability_not_found.zh: 请求的能力或资源不存在。

agent_config_object_required.en: Agent configuration must be an object.

builtin_config_object_required.en: Built-in Agent configuration must be an object.
builtin_config_object_required.zh: 内置 Agent 配置必须是对象。

invalid_model_list_request.en: A provider and base URL are required to fetch models.
invalid_model_list_request.zh: 获取模型列表需要提供服务提供商和基础 URL。

agent_servers_array_required.en: Agent servers must be an array.
agent_servers_array_required.zh: Agent 配置列表必须是数组。

agent_name_reserved.en: msinsight-native is reserved for the built-in Agent.
agent_name_reserved.zh: msinsight-native 是内置 Agent 的保留名称。

agent_auto_name_reserved.en: Agent names ending in (auto) are reserved for discovered agents.
agent_auto_name_reserved.zh: 以 (auto) 结尾的名称仅供自动发现的 Agent 使用。

agent_command_required.zh: 请输入 Agent 启动命令。

agent_args_array_required.en: Agent arguments must be an array.
agent_args_array_required.zh: Agent 启动参数必须是数组。

agent_arg_empty.zh: Agent 启动参数不能包含空值。

existing_agent_immutable.en: Existing agent cannot be deleted or renamed: {agentName}
existing_agent_immutable.zh: 不能删除已有 Agent 或修改其名称：{agentName}

provider_invalid.en: Provider must be openai, openai-compatible or anthropic.
provider_invalid.zh: 服务提供商必须为 openai、openai-compatible 或 anthropic。

context_budget_invalid.en: Context budget must be 200000 or 1000000 tokens.
context_budget_invalid.zh: 上下文预算必须为 200000 或 1000000 个 Token。

compact_threshold_invalid.en: Auto compact threshold must be an integer from 1 to 100.
compact_threshold_invalid.zh: 自动压缩阈值必须是 1 到 100 之间的整数。

active_agent_required.en: An active Agent must be selected.

active_agent_invalid.en: The active Agent must reference a configured Agent.
active_agent_invalid.zh: 当前 Agent 必须是已配置的 Agent。

active_agent_unavailable.en: The active Agent must reference an available discovered Agent.
active_agent_unavailable.zh: 当前 Agent 必须是自动发现且可用的 Agent。

env_key_required.en: Environment variable keys cannot be empty.

env_key_duplicate.en: Environment variable keys must be unique.

timeout_invalid.en: Timeout must be a positive number.

allowlist_flag_invalid.zh: 允许列表开关必须是布尔值。

extra_paths_array_required.en: Additional paths must be an array.
